# ORC contract fixture

orc_split_elim.orc is the 246,402-byte ORC test fixture distributed by the
github.com/scritchley/orc project in its examples directory at commit
06dddf1ad665db0f427c4a8eef303ca041eccdcc.

The fixture is redistributed under the upstream MIT license. The accompanying
orc-fixture-MIT-LICENSE file contains the upstream copyright notice and license
terms. The fixture is used only for deterministic compatibility tests.
